neighbours.label: the article ' a' right after a preposition, opening a group or set phrase ('of a kind', 'any of a group', 'under a set'), as against ' a' after a verb and 'of the'
fire: The festival is the first of a series of events planned for the anniversary.
Each painting in the shop is one of a kind, signed by the artist.
Under a new agreement, farmers will receive higher prices for milk.
Mercury is any of a family of compounds that can poison fish.
The village became part of a larger district after the reform.
This bridge is the last of a line of stone crossings over the river.
With a group of friends, she hiked across the whole island.
The chapel was built as one of a pair of matching towers.
quiet: The festival is the first of the events planned for the anniversary.
Each painting in the shop is unique and signed by the artist.
Under the new agreement, farmers will receive higher prices for milk.
Mercury compounds can poison fish in the lake.
After the reform, the village joined the larger district.
This bridge is the last of the stone crossings over the river.
Together with friends, she hiked across the whole island.
The chapel was built next to the matching towers.
